title: Bug 2204: EventEmitter Memory Leak & Unhandled Rejection in Notification Worker
problem_brief: The notification microservice terminates with `MaxListenersExceededWarning: Possible EventEmitter memory leak detected. 11 error listeners added`. When Redis socket reconnects, unhandled promise rejections trigger process crash. Review the socket connection pool, unit test suite, and listener lifecycle. Fix the dangling listener leak, handle rejection safely, and design an automated leak test.

hints.hint: Every time `acquireClient()` runs, an `error` listener is added with `.on('error')` instead of `.once('error')` and is never removed upon release.
Redis reconnect attempts return a rejected promise that lacked a `.catch()` or try/catch boundary, triggering process.exit(1).

entries.message: (node:4102) MaxListenersExceededWarning: 11 error listeners added to [RedisSocket]. Use emitter.setMaxListeners() to increase limit
UnhandledPromiseRejection: Error: Socket closed abruptly at RedisSocket.onClose (/app/node_modules/@redis/client/dist/lib/client/socket.js:142)
Process exited with code 1 due to unhandled promise rejection in strict mode.
